original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - SPIN1 ITC Experi: SPIN1 ITC Experiments. ITC experiments were performed at 20 °C with a MicroCal VP-ITC microcalorimeter (GE Healthcare) by sequential injection of 8 μL of compound solution (100–300 μM) during 16 s into the sample cell containing 10 μM of His-SPIN1P49-S262 in ITC assay buffer. DMSO was adapted in a syringe and sample cell to 0.1–0.3%. A total of 33 injections were performed with a spacing of 240 s and a reference power of 10 μcal s−1. Automated baseline assignment and peak integration were performed with NITPIC version 1.0.1.56 Isotherms were plotted by global analysis of multiple titrations, with the Simplex algorithm, with SEDPHAT version 10.58.57 Isotherms were subsequently validated by two-dimensional error surface projections at P levels of 0.68 and 0.95 in SEDFIT.58
original_paragraph.Figure 3 caption: Figure 3. Binding affinities of compounds 2 (Kd = 114 ± 4 nM), 10 (Kd = 45 ± 1 nM), and 11 (Kd = 18 ± 2 nM) to SPIN1 determined using ITC. Kd determination experiments were performed in duplicate, and the values are presented as the mean ± SD.
original_paragraph.Figure 5C caption: Figure 5. Compound 18 is a potent and selective inhibitor of SPIN1. (A) Chemical structures of compounds 18 and 19, a negative control of compound 18. (B) Compound 18 potently inhibits SPIN1 in the FP biochemical assay while compound 19 does not. IC50 determination experiments were performed in triplicate, and the values are presented as the mean ± SD. (C) Compound 18, but not compound 19, binds SPIN1 with a high affinity determined using ITC. Kd determination experiments were performed in duplicate, and the values are presented as the mean ± SD. (D) Compound 18 does not bind either G9a or GLP in ITC experiments. (E) Compound 18 does not significantly inhibit the enzymatic activity of 38 epigenetic targets at 1 μM.
original_paragraph.Figure 5D data: G9a and GLP ITC experiments show no significant binding for compound 18.

Cocystal structure of SPIN1 in complex with a H3 peptide; IC50 determination of compounds 1–17 to SPIN1; binding affinities of compounds 13–17 to SPIN1; IC50 determination of compound 11 against G9a and GLP in biochemical assays; binding affinities of compound 18 to SPIN2B, SPIN3, and SPIN4; crystallography data and refinement statistics for the SPIN1-compound 11 complex; compound 18 is selective against 38 epigenetic targets; and 1H NMR, 13C NMR, and LCMS spectra of compounds 11, 18, and 19 (PDF)
